name: 27823 · Enfield, NC
findings: ZIP 27823 (Enfield) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27823 (Enfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 27823 (Enfield) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
